module.purpose: Provides authentication, authorization, Clerk client construction, and file-access guards for the sync worker.
module.summary: This module centralizes Clerk-based request authentication, including websocket access-token fallback and narrowly scoped verification of zero-cache template tokens. It also implements administrative authorization and database-backed file read/write access checks, including ownership, group roles, sharing state, and editable-link requirements. Database pools are always destroyed after access checks, while authentication failures are represented as null results or HTTP status errors depending on the helper.
module.businessContext: Supports tldraw's sync-worker endpoints and zero-cache connections. Failures can reject valid users, expose unauthorized file operations, or prevent administrative workflows.
functions: requireAuth (~L8-15): Requires an authenticated request and throws on anonymous access.
getClerkClient (~L17-22): Creates a Clerk client from environment credentials.
getAuthorizedParties (~L24-37): Builds environment-specific allowed JWT origins.
getAuth (~L39-63): Authenticates requests using Clerk headers, cookies, or query tokens.
getZeroAuth (~L91-121): Verifies zero-template tokens before falling back to standard authentication.
requireWriteAccessToFile (~L127-177): Enforces ownership, group, sharing, and edit access.
hasReadAccessToFile (~L201-230): Checks readable file access and returns a safe file projection.
requireAdminAccess (~L232-244): Requires a verified tldraw.com administrator identity.
requireAdminAccessToRequest (~L246-248): Applies administrative authorization to an authenticated request.

io: Writes rejected zero-template token diagnostics to console.error.
network: Calls Clerk authentication, token verification, and user lookup APIs.
env: Reads Clerk keys, deployment environment, and worker name from Environment.
mutationOfArg: Mutates the cloned request headers when copying an access token from the query string.

A shared file grants write access only when its sharedLinkType is exactly edit.
edgeCases: If authentication fails, requireAuth's failure is propagated and no access is granted.

If the file has an owning group and the user's role can access files, the function returns successfully.
If the file is not shared, the function throws StatusError with status 403 and message File is not shared.
If the file is shared with a link type other than edit, the function throws StatusError with status 403 and message File is shared but not for editing.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Authentication failures are propagated; a missing file or insufficient write authorization throws StatusError.
